stories.title: India's Ramsar tally reaches 98
stories.body: Patna Bird Sanctuary (UP) as 97th and Chhari-Dhand Conservation Reserve (Gujarat) as 98th on World Wetlands Day (Feb 2); theme 'Wetlands and Traditional Knowledge: Celebrating Cultural Heritage'.

one_liners: India's Ramsar tally reaches 98 — Patna Bird Sanctuary (UP) as 97th and Chhari-Dhand Conservation Reserve (Gujarat) as 98th on World Wetlands Day (Feb 2)
